term.label: cytosolic_rRNA_2S_gene

definition.text: A gene that encodes for 2S ribosomal RNA, which functions as a component of the large subunit of the ribosome in Drosophila and at least some other Diptera.

comments: Added as a request from FlyBase. See GitHub Issue #507. Adjusted heirarchy and names of rRNA_gene terms at the request of Steven Marygold GitHub Issue #513 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/513).
